label: 等创建页
js: for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { refresh(); if (root && (view() === 'protagonistCreate' || view() === 'lobby')) break; await sleep(500); } return view();

label: 撞名自动换名建角
js: refresh(); const flow = root.protagonistCreateFlow; const st = flow.state; st.formState = Object.assign({}, st.formState, { protagonistName: '圣契64', nameAuto: true }); if (flow.nameInput) flow.nameInput.string = '圣契64'; root.submitProtagonistCreate(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { await sleep(500); if (view() !== 'protagonistCreate') break; } return JSON.stringify({ view: view(), name: st.formState.protagonistName, error: st.formState.error, retries: flow.autoNameRetries, tried: Array.from(flow.triedAutoNames) });

label: 序幕播放中
js: await sleep(4000); return JSON.stringify({ prologue: !!document.getElementById('lootchain-prologue'), view: view() });

label: 等序幕结束
js: for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { if (!document.getElementById('lootchain-prologue')) break; await sleep(500); } return JSON.stringify({ gone: !document.getElementById('lootchain-prologue'), seen: localStorage.getItem('lootchain.prologue.seen.{UID}'), pending: localStorage.getItem('lootchain.awaken.pending.{UID}') });

label: 觉醒演出
js: let ok = false; const t0 = Date.now(); let last = null; for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) { refresh(); if (root && root.awakenCinematic && root.awakenCinematic.active) { ok = true; break; } last = { view: view(), boot: root && root.bootPreloadActive, town: !!(t && t.isMounted && t.isMounted()), stage: t && t.awakenStageReady ? t.awakenStageReady() : null, layer: root && root.lobbyHasOpenLayer ? root.lobbyHasOpenLayer() : null, dialog: !!(root && root.worldDialog), prologue: !!document.getElementById('lootchain-prologue') }; await sleep(500); } await sleep(2500); return JSON.stringify({ started: ok, waitedMs: Date.now() - t0, last, pending: localStorage.getItem('lootchain.awaken.pending.{UID}') });

label: 契约之选未选卡
js: refresh(); if (root.awakenCinematic.active) root.awakenCinematic.skip(); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { if (root.contractPick) break; await sleep(500); } await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ contract: !!root.contractPick, n: root.contractPick ? root.contractPick.candidates.length : 0, queue: root.popupQueue.size });

label: 契约之选选中一张
js: refresh(); root.selectStarterContract(root.contractPick.candidates[0].heroCode); await sleep(1200); return root.contractPick.selected;

label: 订立后进村HUD
js: refresh(); root.confirmStarterContract(); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { if (!root.contractPick) break; await sleep(500); } await sleep(5000); refresh(); const icons = []; const g = find('LobbySystemIcons'); if (g) g.children.forEach(c => icons.push(c.name)); return JSON.stringify({ icons, hint: !!find('AutoWalkHint'), level: root.currentLobbyProfile().playerLevel, evo: root.evolutionPendingCount(), queue: root.popupQueue.size });

label: 移动教学遮罩_契约后自动出
js: refresh(); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (t.moveGuideActive()) break; await sleep(250); } await sleep(1300); refresh(); return JSON.stringify({ active: t.moveGuideActive(), mask: !!find('LobbyMoveGuide'), skip: !!find('GuideSkip'), hand: !!find('MoveGuideHand'), keys: !!find('MoveGuideKey_W'), hint: !!find('AutoWalkHint'), busy: root.lobbyPopupBusy(), queue: root.popupQueue.size });

label: 移动教学_点追踪条被遮罩拦
after: await sleep(700); refresh(); return JSON.stringify({ walking: t.isAutoWalking(), active: t.moveGuideActive() });

label: 移动教学_拖摇杆走一步
drag: refresh(); const p = scr(find('LobbyTownJoyBase')); return { x0: p.x, y0: p.y, x1: p.x + 10, y1: p.y - 60 };
after: await sleep(200); refresh(); return JSON.stringify({ active: t.moveGuideActive(), steps: t.moveGuide ? t.moveGuide.steps : null, moved: t.moveGuide ? Math.round(t.moveGuide.moved) : null });

label: 移动教学_走满收起_追踪条接力
drag: refresh(); const p = scr(find('LobbyTownJoyBase')); return { x0: p.x, y0: p.y, x1: p.x + 60, y1: p.y - 10 };
after: await sleep(450); refresh(); return JSON.stringify({ active: t.moveGuideActive(), mask: !!find('LobbyMoveGuide'), hint: !!find('AutoWalkHint'), done: root.storyGuideDone.has('V01'), praise: texts(200).filter(s => s.indexOf('走得不错') >= 0), queue: root.popupQueue.size });

label: 移动教学_重开后点跳过
js: refresh(); root.storyGuideDone.delete('V01'); root.moveGuideQueuedUid = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (t.moveGuideActive()) break; await sleep(250); } await sleep(700); return JSON.stringify({ again: t.moveGuideActive() });
after: await sleep(900); refresh(); return JSON.stringify({ active: t.moveGuideActive(), local: localStorage.getItem('lc_story_guide_skip_{UID}_V01'), flag: root.guideFlags.has('skip:V01'), blocked: root.storyGuideBlocked('V01'), hint: !!find('AutoWalkHint') });

label: 说明卡先记看过_本批不测
js: localStorage.setItem('lc_feature_intro_{UID}', JSON.stringify(['terminal', 'bag', 'forge', 'daily', 'crystal', 'raid', 'codex', 'guild', 'explore', 'worldmap'])); refresh(); root.featureIntros.uid = 0; return 'ok';

label: 终端锁格
js: refresh(); root.openLobbyTerminalPanel(); await sleep(2500); const locks = []; cc.director.getScene().walk(n => { if (n.name.indexOf('LockText_') === 0 && n.activeInHierarchy) { const l = n.getComponent(cc.Label); locks.push(n.name.slice(9) + ':' + (l ? l.string : '')); } }); return JSON.stringify(locks);

label: 点锁住的召唤格
js: refresh(); root.runLobbyTerminalAction('gacha'); await sleep(700); return JSON.stringify({ terminal: root.lobbyTerminalOpen, floats: texts(200).filter(s => s.indexOf('开放') >= 0) });

label: 点追踪条自动寻路
js: refresh(); root.closeLobbyTerminalPanel(); await sleep(800); const n = find('LobbyWorldQuestTracker'); const had = !!find('AutoWalkHint'); tap(n); await sleep(1200); return JSON.stringify({ tracker: !!n, hadHint: had, hintAfter: !!find('AutoWalkHint'), walking: t.isAutoWalking(), pos: t.leaderPosition(), map: root.worldMapPanel ? 'opened' : 'none' });

label: 走到目标
js: refresh(); for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) { if (!t.isAutoWalking()) break; await sleep(500); } await sleep(800); return JSON.stringify({ walking: t.isAutoWalking(), pos: t.leaderPosition(), near: (t.nearbyInteracts ? t.nearbyInteracts() : []).map(x => x.label), talkPulse: !!find('TalkPulse') });

label: 对话中走到隐藏点_应排队
js: refresh(); root.openWorldNpcDialog('CHIEF'); await sleep(600); const okWalk = t.autoWalkTo(260, 150); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { if (!t.isAutoWalking()) break; await sleep(500); } await sleep(3500); return JSON.stringify({ okWalk, pos: t.leaderPosition(), dialog: root.worldDialog ? root.worldDialog.mode : null, poi: !!root.worldPoiDialog, queue: root.popupQueue.size, overlay: !!find('LobbyPoiOverlay') });

label: 交任务后弹发现卡
js: refresh(); root.worldDialogPrimary(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(500); if (!root.worldDialog || root.worldDialog.mode !== 'claim') break; } await sleep(1500); if (root.worldDialog) { root.closeWorldDialog(); } await sleep(2500); return JSON.stringify({ dialog: root.worldDialog ? root.worldDialog.mode : null, poi: !!root.worldPoiDialog, evo: !!root.evolutionPick, queue: root.popupQueue.size, level: root.currentLobbyProfile().playerLevel });

label: 关发现卡后进化第一次自动弹
js: refresh(); if (root.worldPoiDialog) root.closeWorldPoiDialog(); for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { if (root.evolutionPick) break; await sleep(500); } await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ evo: !!root.evolutionPick, pending: root.evolutionState ? root.evolutionState.pendingCount : null, fromHud: root.evolutionFromHud, later: !!find('Later'), level: root.currentLobbyProfile().playerLevel });

label: 稍后再选后右上进化钮
js: refresh(); if (root.evolutionPick) root.closeEvolutionPickLater(); await sleep(1500); const icons = []; const g = find('LobbySystemIcons'); if (g) g.children.forEach(c => icons.push(c.name)); const evo = find('LobbySystemIcon_evolution'); let badge = ''; if (evo) { const b = evo.getChildByName('LobbyCountBadge'); const l = b && b.getChildByName('Num') && b.getChildByName('Num').getComponent(cc.Label); badge = l ? l.string : ''; } return JSON.stringify({ evoOpen: !!root.evolutionPick, icons, badge });

label: 从右上进化钮打开并确认
js: refresh(); tap(find('LobbySystemIcon_evolution')); await sleep(1500); const opened = !!root.evolutionPick; const fromHud = root.evolutionFromHud; root.confirmEvolution(); for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { await sleep(500); if (!root.evolutionPick || !root.evolutionPick.busy) break; } await sleep(1500); return JSON.stringify({ opened, fromHud, stillOpen: !!root.evolutionPick, pending: root.evolutionState ? root.evolutionState.pendingCount : null, evoIcon: !!find('LobbySystemIcon_evolution') });
